title: The Kindly Choir
author: Lior Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
